# Feature request

## Problem

What can't you do today, and why does it matter?

## Proposed behavior

What rtunk should do instead. Sketch the command, flag, or config shape if
you have one in mind.

## Scope check

- [ ] This isn't the trunk daemon, Merge Queue, Flaky Tests, a hosted/SaaS
      dashboard, or `login`/`logout`/`whoami`/cloud-account functionality.

These are permanently out of scope — see
[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md#permanently-out-of-scope) — and any proposal
touching them will be closed without further discussion.
